correctness.rationale: The original calculations are mathematically consistent; the substantive repair changes the contribution, not its coefficients. For the retained m>=3 case, support maximization and central symmetry give the range and formula. At the minimum set delta=w^2/4-1/m; for Y_0=a the simplex in the m-1 remaining independent transverse coordinates has volume [m delta-(m-1)a]^(m-1)/(m-1)!, with 0<=a<=m delta/(m-1). All transverse squares are 1/m+O_m(delta), strictly positive for small delta, so the product Dirichlet density is a^(-1/2) times a uniformly smooth factor. Integration with B(1/2,m) and delta=epsilon/sqrt(m)+epsilon^2/4 gives the repaired coefficient and relative O_m(epsilon) error. At the upper edge the single-circle neighborhoods each have a Beta((m-1)/2,1) lower tail, and overlap forces the sum of all m transverse squares below 2(1-w^2/4). The Beta(m/2,1/2) estimate controls the total overlap at the stated order. The original m=2 density follows by differentiating the CDF, and rotational symmetry gives the stated second moment using E|cos(2 Phi)|=2/pi; these are no longer contributions. The repaired comparison also derives the weak limit from the appropriate Dirichlet-maximum scaling and independent normalized transverse vector. The frozen numerical checks were inspected but not executed; the asymptotic assertions follow analytically.
